newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: RSL takes 30 pct of Portugal's Maxitel.
newsitem.headline: RSL takes 30 pct of Portugal's Maxitel.

text.p: U.S. telecommunications firm RSL Communications Inc has agreed to take a 30 percent stake in Portuguese communications company Maxitel-Servicos e Gestao de Telecomunicacoes, Maxitel said.

"Under the agreement with RSL Com, the company takes a 30 percent stake in the capital of Maxitel and takes two seats on the board. Maxitel will take one seat on the board of RSL Com Europe," a statement said.
The agreement will enable Maxitel to offer its clients access to the global telecommunications network of RSL Communications, part of a group of companies owned by Ronald Lauder, it added.
